What is This Part?
This part attaches to the engine compartment firewall and is a valve that connects the radiator water line to the heater core.
The valve can be opened and closed by use of a cable that is controlled at the Heater Panel thus allowing hot water to flow to the heater core to produce hot air.
This is a very hard to find Part.
Significantly outlasts after-market valves because of it™s superior construction.
Direct Replacement
